% A revtex4 article with headings at four levels. revtex's \l@section
% reads \tocleft@section, which the class defines only in
% \tableofcontents, so measuring its table of contents failed the build.
\documentclass{revtex4}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\begin{document}
\title{Revtoc}
\author{Someone}
\maketitle
\section{First section}
Text of the first section.
\subsection{A subsection}
Text of the subsection.
\subsubsection{A subsubsection}
Text of the subsubsection.
\paragraph{A paragraph.}
Text of the paragraph.
\section{Second section}
Text of the second section.
\end{document}
